messages:
maria_cs: Quick weekly Bento health check — token usage WoW -3% but QoQ +18%. Seeing p95 latency spike Tuesday (420ms -> 610ms) and error rate up to 1.8% at peak. Link to dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/bento :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ajay: I dove into traces — KV cache hit dropped from ~84% to 62% during the spike. Also noticed more frequent model fallback to quantized-v1 which raises CPU/GPU contention. No obvious infra-wide incident.
kevin_sre: noted. Ran `rbctl get pods --selector=customer=bento -o wide` — pod gpu-2 had 3 restarts around 14:12 UTC. OOM logs point to memory pressure during batched requests.
sam_prod: Flags from product: Bento's route currently has batch_target=16 and prefix_cache disabled. Recommend: batch_target -> 32 and enable prefix_cache for the customer route. Quick override example: `PUT /routes/bento/config {"batch_target":32, "prefix_cache":true}`
nora_csm: Customer called this morning worried about spend — CFO flagged token cost QoQ +12%. I offered a short enablement on prompt engineering to reduce unnecessary tokens; tentative Wed 11:30 PT. I can pitch reserved burst capacity as a stopgap if cost impact is acceptable.
ajay: Also worth noting the KV eviction rate increased at the same time — likely due to larger concurrent sessions from their new feature. If we increase cache size or pin hot prefixes we should recover hit rate.
kevin_sre: I can do a controlled burst scale for Bento tomorrow 09:00 PT and pin fallback policy to avoid quantized fallback on mild pressure. Will coordinate with infra to avoid extra cost.
usage-bot: Summary for Bento — tokens: WoW -3%, QoQ +18%; p95 latency: 420ms -> 610ms (Tue spike); error rate baseline 0.2% -> peak 1.8%; KV cache hit 84% -> 62%.
maria_cs: Thank you. Proposed action items: 1) Kevin — execute burst scale + pin fallback (due Thu 09:00 PT). 2) Sam — apply route override with batch_target=32 + prefix_cache (by EOD). 3) Ajay — monitor KV eviction and share 24h heatmap. 4) Nora/maria — run 30-min enablement Wed and share cost-reduction playbook.
sam_prod: I'll roll the config as a canary to 10% then full if metrics stabilize. Will post canary metrics after 30m.
kevin_sre: Will update runbook and notify oncall. Quick command I'll run: `rbctl scale --customer=bento --delta=+3 --reason="weekly-bento-burst"`
nora_csm: I'll draft the enablement agenda and include token-saving examples + quick wins.
ajay: I'll also add an automated check: if KV hit < 70% for > 15m trigger alert and run `rbctl cache inspect bento --top=20` to list hot keys.
maria_cs: Perfect. We'll reconvene in this thread after the canary. If anyone sees renewed errors escalate to incidents/ channel. :thumbsup:
usage-bot: Action reminders set: kevin_sre, sam_prod, ajay, nora_csm — check-ins scheduled.
